disputes.claim: The type Ia supernova distance-redshift relation rules out large local underdensities (|δ| > 20%) at the 4-5σ confidence level.

record.name: KBC void
record.notes: The underdensity is measured as a function of distance from us, so it is a sphere about the observer; the paper gives no offset or anisotropy. Its fields cover only part of the sky (UKIDSS-LAS with SDSS, GAMA and 2dFGRS, and 2M++ at low redshift). Mazurenko et al. model bulk flows assuming the void is real, which supports rather than disputes it.

papers.title: Evidence for a ~300 Megaparsec Scale Under-density in the Local Galaxy Distribution
The Local Perspective on the Hubble Tension: Local Structure Does Not Impact Measurement of the Hubble Constant

locator.quote: We find a local (z < 0.07, D < 300 h70^-1 Mpc) luminosity density that is in good agreement with previous studies.
Beyond z ~ 0.07, we detect a rising luminosity density that reaches a value of roughly ~1.5 times higher than that measured locally at z > 0.1.
